query: Best street food spots and street food markets in Hanoi

places.title: Hanoi Weekend Night Market
places.text: A bustling street market stretching from Hang Dao to Dong Xuan Market, active every weekend. It features a vast array of street food stalls selling traditional Vietnamese snacks, grilled skewers, and local specialties alongside apparel and souvenirs.
places.address: 104 P. Hàng Đào, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Dong Xuan Market (Dong Xuan Alley)
places.text: Known as the largest covered market in Hanoi, its side alley (Ngo Dong Xuan) is a legendary street food hub. It is famous for Bun Oc (snail noodles), Che (sweet soup), and various crispy fried snacks popular with locals during the day and early evening.
places.opening_hours: Monday-Sunday: 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Alley stays active until late evening)
places.address: Ng. Đồng Xuân, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Ta Hien Beer Street
places.text: Often called the 'International Crossroads,' this street is the heart of Hanoi's nightlife. It is packed with plastic stools where visitors enjoy 'Bia Hoi' (fresh beer) paired with street snacks like fermented pork rolls (Nem Chua) and roasted bird.
places.opening_hours: Peak hours Friday-Sunday: 7:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Bars open daily)
places.address: 41-36 P. Lương Ngọc Quyến, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Phở Gia Truyền Bát Đàn
places.text: One of Hanoi's most iconic Pho spots, famous for its traditional beef noodle soup and the long queues of locals and tourists alike. The broth is renowned for its clear, deep savory flavor and tender beef slices.
places.address: 49 P. Bát Đàn, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Banh Mi 25
places.text: A world-famous sandwich shop that started as a humble street stall. It offers a wide variety of Banh Mi fillings, including classic pate and pork, with fresh, crispy baguettes and a dedicated seating area across the street.
places.address: 25 P. Hàng Cá, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Bun Cha Dac Kim
places.text: A staple for Bun Cha (grilled pork with vermicelli) in the Old Quarter. Known for its generous portions and flavorful grilled meat served with a basket of fresh herbs and dipping sauce.
places.address: 1 P. Hàng Mành, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Pho 10 Ly Quoc Su
places.text: Highly regarded for its consistent quality and flavorful beef Pho. Located near St. Joseph's Cathedral, it is a favorite for those looking for a slightly more comfortable street food experience without sacrificing authentic taste.
places.address: 10 P. Lý Quốc Sư, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Tong Duy Tan Food Street
places.text: Hanoi's most famous 24-hour food street, offering a wide selection of local dishes from fried rice (Com Dao) to hotpots. It is the go-to destination for late-night cravings in the city.
places.address: P. Tống Duy Tân, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Cửa hàng bánh gối Lý Quốc Sư
places.text: Also known as Quan Goc Da, this spot is famous for 'Banh Goi' (pillow-shaped fried dumplings) and other deep-fried Hanoi specialties like shrimp cakes and spring rolls served with tangy dipping sauce.
places.address: 52 P. Lý Quốc Sư, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

query: Best street food spots and street food markets in Hanoi

places.title: Ta Hien Beer Street
places.text: A bustling and iconic street food and nightlife hub in Hanoi's Old Quarter. Known for its vibrant atmosphere, plastic stools spilling onto the pavements, cheap draft beer (Bia Hoi), and an array of delicious street foods like barbecued skewers, fried street snacks, and steamed buns.
places.opening_hours: Friday: 7:00 – 11:00 PM, Saturday: 7:00 – 11:00 PM, Sunday: 7:00 – 11:00 PM
places.address: 41-36 P. Lương Ngọc Quyến, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Banh Mi 25
places.text: One of the absolute classic street food destinations in Hanoi. This widely popular spot serves incredibly fresh, crispy Vietnamese baguettes filled with traditional options like house-made pate, pork, chicken, as well as a variety of modern and vegetarian variations.
places.address: 25 P. Hàng Cá, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000, Vietnam

places.title: Phố ẩm thực Tống Duy Tân
places.text: This dedicated food street is widely celebrated as Hanoi's premier late-night dining destination. It features a concentrated strip of open-air stalls and casual eateries serving local street food specialties like chicken noodle soups, hotpots, and 'com dao' (stir-fried rice).
places.address: 2RHV+FHW, Cấm Chỉ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Dong xuan market
places.text: Located in a historic market hall in the Old Quarter, this destination features a legendary nearby street food alley (Dong Xuan Alley) filled with local stalls. It is a fantastic spot to try authentic Northern Vietnamese culinary staples like snail noodle soup (bun oc) and sweet dessert soups (che) at incredibly affordable local prices.
places.address: Chợ Đồng Xuân, 23 P. Cầu Đông, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000, Vietnam
